cases.answer: The two figures use different denominators. The abstract gives 8 patients (10.7%), which is 8 of all 75 patients in the pembrolizumab cohort. The results give 8 of 34 (23.5%), which is 8 of only the 34 patients who actually started adjuvant pembrolizumab. The discussion rounds the same figure to 11%. Both describe the same 8 patients. The overall figure is 51 of 75 (68.0%) discontinued due to AEs: 22 stopped preoperatively, 21 did not start adjuvant therapy, and 8 stopped it.

cases.answer: pCR was 56.0% (42 of 75) in the pembrolizumab cohort and 46.1% (47 of 102) in the cohort treated without pembrolizumab. The article reports no statistical test of this difference. On design, the pembrolizumab cohort was 75 consecutive patients treated at Helsinki from December 2022 to August 2024. The comparison cohort was 102 nonmatched consecutive TNBC patients diagnosed since 1 Jan 2021 and operated on by 1 Sept 2024, mostly treated before pembrolizumab was adopted at the hospital or with a contraindication to it. The whole study is retrospective, single-center and real-world. Median EFS follow-up differed: 22 months for the pembrolizumab cohort and 35 months for the comparison cohort.

cases.answer: No. The Zhongshan stage III cohort did not show a statistically significant DFS improvement. DFS did not differ significantly between neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy and chemotherapy alone (P = 0.129), even though pCR, MPR and ORR were significantly higher with chemoimmunotherapy. The authors attribute the null DFS result to short follow-up and immature data. The only significant DFS difference was between MPR and non-MPR patients (P = 0.048), which is not a comparison of treatment arms.

cases.answer: The review treats the two pathways as parallel, complementary routes to the DC-stimulating DAMPs. ER stress, acting through the PERK–eIF2α axis (the integrated stress response), promotes surface exposure of calreticulin (CALR), the 'eat-me' signal that lets DCs phagocytose dying tumor cells. Autophagy sustains ATP secretion from stressed or dying cells. Extracellular ATP stimulates P2RX7 on DCs, triggering inflammasome activation and IL-1β and IL-18 secretion, and DC recruitment. ER stress–PERK–eIF2α signaling mainly drives the qualitative conversion of cell death into an immunogenic state, while autophagy helps ensure release of the immunostimulatory mediators.

claims.quote:

promoting the surface exposure of calreticulin and other 
chaperones, thereby serving as ‘eat-me’ signals for dendritic cells

claims.quote:
Autophagy contributes to ICD by facilitating

claims.claim: Extracellular ATP acts on P2RX7 on DCs, leading to IL-1β and IL-18 secretion.
claims.quote:
Extracellular ATP further 
amplifies this process by stimulating the purinergic receptor

subsequent secretion of proinflammatory cytokines, notably IL-1β 
and IL-18.

claims.claim: CALR is described as an eat-me signal that facilitates DC phagocytosis.
claims.quote:
CALR translocates from the endoplasmic 
reticulum (ER) to the plasma membrane surface during ICD, serving

claims.claim: The two pathways are complementary.
claims.quote:
Thus, ER stress-PERK-eIF2α 
signaling primarily contributes to the qualitative conversion of 
tumor cell death into an immunogenic state, whereas autophagy 
helps ensure the release of key immunostimulatory mediators.

cases.answer: The review distinguishes the three cold subtypes by where immune cells are and whether they are functional. Immune-excluded tumors have immune cells physically restricted at the periphery that fail to penetrate the tumor parenchyma. Immune-desert tumors completely lack significant immune infiltration. Immunosuppressed tumors have immune cells present but functionally restrained by dominant suppressive signals (Tregs, M2-like TAMs, MDSCs, TGF-β, IL-10, adenosine). The review also suggests each may respond differently to ICD: desert tumors may need ICD to first enhance antigen release, DC recruitment and T-cell priming; excluded tumors may benefit when ICD is combined with strategies that overcome stromal and vascular barriers; immunosuppressed tumors may benefit when ICD is paired with approaches that relieve suppressive pathways.

claims.claim: Excluded tumors have immune cells restricted at the periphery, while desert tumors lack infiltration.
claims.quote:
“immune-excluded”, where immune cells are physically restricted 
at the periphery and fail to penetrate the tumor parenchyma, or as 
immune-desert, completely lacking significant immune infiltration

claims.quote:

which lack effective priming and baseline immune infiltration, may

claims.quote:
Immune-excluded tumors may 
derive greater benefit from ICD when it is combined with strategies

claims.claim: Immunosuppressed tumors may benefit when ICD is paired with approaches relieving suppressive pathways.
claims.quote:
with approaches that relieve dominant suppressive pathways, such 
as TGF-β-, myeloid-, or adenosine-targeted interventions.
